issues.reason: Source is licensed only when the PP answers whence (decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest); 'shield a cove FROM north winds' names what is warded off, not an origin, so (Source $e1 north_wind) asserts a provenance the text does not state and the licensed form is the preposition-named oblique (From $e1 north_wind).

The whenever rule mints the response as a Skolem event PER OCCURRENCE and the scope rule makes a dependent existential a function of every universal scoping over it, so (sk_burn $lt) keyed on the lantern alone shares one burn across distinct shield occurrences $e1 (two spires shielding the same cove), stacking several During anchors on one event.

gaps_confirmed: 'through <season>' as an extent adverbial: During is licensed only for during/while/throughout over a reified outer eventuality and Start/End/Measure need stated bounds or a figure, so nothing records an eventuality holding throughout a named span — (Time … winter) under-records without over-claiming
new_gaps: a PP-restricted bare-plural subject of a whenever-rule consequent ('lanterns in that cove'): the restricted-kind-subject rule covers an adjectival restriction on a top-level generic only, so hoisting the NP into the premise as (Member $lt lantern) (LocatedIn $lt $c) is an improvisation the set neither licenses nor bars
a bare season word as a Time constant ('winter' with no deictic): only deictic seasons (last_spring, next_summer) and day-parts are listed as bare Time symbols
defect_summary: Issue 0: (From $e1 north_wind), the surface-preposition oblique, in place of Source; issue 1: mint the burn per occurrence and per lantern — (sk_burn $e1 $lt) (or of every premise universal) with (During (sk_burn $e1 $lt) $e1); the remaining atoms stand as emitted.
notes: Compound handling (cliff_spire genus only; north_wind genus plus the positional modifier north), Manner for the -ly adverb kept in surface form, Patient for the burning lanterns, and the During tie all follow the instruction set.
